name: Kenan
overview: Kenan is a male figure in the biblical genealogies, uniquely identified as the son of Enosh according to Genesis 5:9. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional notes recorded about him in Scripture beyond his place in the early patriarchal lineage.
namesAndTitles: Kenan is known by this single proper name, with an alternate spelling 'Cainan' appearing in Luke 3:37. Neither name is indicated as given directly by God, and no specific meanings are provided for these names in the scriptural references given.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Kenan as the father of Mahalalel (Genesis 5:13) and infers that he is the son of Enosh (Genesis 5:9). These relationships place him within the early genealogical line descending from Adam, though no further family details are provided.
scriptureSignificance: Kenan holds significance as a link in the godly lineage that extends from Adam through Seth, preserving the knowledge of God in the antediluvian period. As the son of Enosh and father of Mahalalel, he is an ancestor to notable biblical figures such as Noah and Abraham, thus contributing to the continuity of God's covenantal promises before the flood.
